criteria.claim: build_inspector's PROVED re-judge (proof_covers_the_ticket) re-runs proof_coverage.lacks() for a ticket only when an input that judgement read has changed, so an unchanged ticket is answered from the record of its last judgement and an inspect() spends the resolver only on what moved.
covers: proof_coverage.lacks gains a recorded-inputs cache. One judgement runs under a recorder: a sys.addaudithook 'open' hook, scoped by a flag to that one call, reco
